story.title: Story 5: Reopen and Degraded Provenance States

result.reviewScopeSummary: Verified Story 5 against the story, full tech-design set, test plan, current onboarding baseline, review/package client and server code paths, process materials read path, and the main server/client/integration tests for reopen, degraded provenance, and error-classification behavior.

newFindings.title: Stale package-member selections collapse the review workspace instead of reloading bounded degraded state
newFindings.evidence: The client already has a workspace-reload fallback for stale artifact-version selections (`apps/platform/client/app/bootstrap.ts:1019-1065`, `1188-1238`), but `selectPackageMember()` does not use it. On any `ApiRequestError` from `GET /review/packages/:packageId?memberId=...`, it patches `reviewWorkspace.error` directly (`apps/platform/client/app/bootstrap.ts:1266-1352`). The server intentionally returns `404 PACKAGE_MEMBER_UNAVAILABLE` for an explicit stale member (`apps/platform/server/routes/review.ts:393-410`; covered by `tests/service/server/package-review-api.test.ts:557-585`), while workspace bootstrap intentionally preserves the package shell with `target.status: 'ready'` and `selectedMember.status: 'unavailable'` (`tests/integration/review-workspace.test.ts:868-901`). Because `apps/platform/client/features/review/review-workspace-page.ts:223-235` treats any `reviewWorkspace.error` as a page-level failure, the stale-member click path hides the rest of the package and available targets instead of showing the bounded degraded state that `apps/platform/client/features/review/package-review-panel.ts:65-96` already supports. Existing client coverage only exercises the artifact-version fallback (`tests/service/client/version-switcher.test.ts:321-390`); `tests/service/client/package-member-nav.test.ts:168-244` covers only out-of-order successful responses, so this regression is currently untested.

mockOrShimAuditFindings: No material production-path mocks/shims were found in the reviewed story surfaces; fake auth services, fake Convex contexts, and `InMemoryPlatformStore` usages remained confined to test files.
additionalObservations: Most Story 5 server/bootstrap behavior is already present in the branch; the blocking gap is localized to the client follow-up package-member selection path.
Both verification gates passed, so the stale-member regression currently sits outside automated coverage.
Traceability is somewhat noisy: several relevant tests still use older Story 6-style test names even though they provide Story 5 evidence.
